top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on a simple, quantitative and distinct idea: magic-wavelength trapping cancels the light shift so many neutral atoms are interrogated free of Doppler and recoil shifts. It has been independently reproduced at the 10^-18 level in several laboratories, theory and measurement agree on the systematics, and the Katori and Ye two-name split with a citation resting on the lattice clock itself is defensible and separable from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is a mature condensed-matter alternative but overlaps the 2016 topological-phases prize and leaves the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and Hasan credit questions open under a three-name cap; it is still preferable to no award.
